notes: `jars.sorted { $0.lastPathComponent < $1.lastPathComponent }.last` (line 778) is a **raw string** comparison, not the numeric/version-aware compare `ComponentVersionParsing.isVersionNewer` uses elsewhere -- "paper-1.21.4-..." sorts after "paper-1.21.10-..." because the character `'4'` (0x34) is greater than `'1'` (0x31) at the first differing position, even though 1.21.10 is the numerically newer Minecraft version. This is a real quirk to preserve exactly, not a bug to silently fix in the port: `updatePaperFromLatestTemplate` (line 604-608) trusts whatever this returns as "latest".
